D1.policy: Ethnicity determines the native language(s) through fixed era-specific bindings. No upbringing override, home-language chooser or additional bilingual selector.

D2.configuration: Existing in-game FutureProg editing; no new seeder configuration questions, tier tables or proficiency UI. Tier labels are content metadata, not new persisted skill levels.

D3.policy: Broad educational/contact electives; optional 0..1 choices by default. Ethnic/native grants and explicit learned-background grants remain mandatory. Existing generic skill groups are reused.

D4.policy: Explicit learned backgrounds receive Literacy; ordinary language ownership does not imply literacy. Script knowledge follows specified writing traditions, not all scripts associated with a language.

D5.policy: Keep existing ethnicity-first naming. Do not implement adopted-name choices, profile-switching screens or multiple-name identities.

D6.policy: Deliver researched name entries, source scope, dates or date limitations, variant grouping and explicit exceptions. Do not make Codex invent names or hide an unverified pool behind a generic fallback.
D6.residual_gap: No defensible new Old Prussian feminine pool retrieved; preserve legacy and do not activate a fictitious replacement. Small local feminine samples are disclosed, not padded.
